title: Surreal Moon Eclipse
description: A large cracked circular form resembling a blood moon dominates the center, containing a surreal composite face split between a green-skinned figure with a yellow eye on the left and a black Anubis-like dog head with red eyes on the right. A vibrant red rose sits at the center where the faces meet, with colorful paint dripping down from the circle against a dark, ruined landscape with dead trees under a starry night sky.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting featuring a massive cracked circular moon in a starry night sky. Inside the moon is a split composite face: on the left a green-skinned figure with golden eye, on the right a black jackal-headed Anubis with glowing red eyes. A vibrant red rose blooms at the center where the two halves meet. Colorful paint in blue, green, orange and red drips heavily from the bottom of the circle. Foreground shows a desolate landscape with dead twisted trees and ruined buildings.
